verdict.rationale: EBANX documents outbound webhooks: it sends an HTTP POST to a merchant-configured Notification URL with payment and status data plus digital-signature headers, and retries failed deliveries multiple times. That is a registrable callback a programmatic consumer can receive. missing for 10: evidence of per-event-type subscription or event coverage beyond payment status (e.g., payouts, chargebacks, refunds), documentation of how the URL is registered (API vs dashboard), independent or hands-on corroboration.
